Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: single raster balance-of-power UI emblem for Hearts of Iron IV, eventual export 78x88 pixels. Create the emblem for the Captains' Collegium, a collective military council. A compact round dark gunmetal medallion with antique gold rim and thick golden laurel branches along left and right lower sides, tied together at the bottom. Within the dark circle, exactly three dignified military officer head-and-shoulder busts sculpted as simplified silver and muted gold metal relief, facing forward: one central officer slightly forward, two flank officers behind, conveying collective command. No realistic skin colors, all figures are embossed metal, no tiny detailed faces. A small simple dark command-table edge across the lower interior can ground the busts but do not overcrowd. Match traditional grand-strategy UI icon finish: hand-painted metallic highlights, bevels, aged gold warm yellow edges, dark recessed steel center, very crisp readable silhouette, top-left highlights and lower-right shadows. Nearly circular badge centered in a slightly taller 39:44 canvas, with about 10 percent transparent space around silhouette and a little more space above and below. Transparent background outside the complete medallion, no rectangle, no drop shadow outside it. No letters, no text, no numbers, no modern flat vector look, no jewels, no crown, no flags, no stars, no weapons. One isolated icon only, not an icon sheet. The design must remain clear at 78x88 pixels. The paired icon is a dark metal roundel with gold laurels and crossed silver swords; match that metallic palette and visual weight while keeping the three officer busts as this emblem's subject.

Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a single Hearts of Iron IV advisor portrait icon for the A-Discord mod. Image 1 is the exact advisor-card layout and frame reference, not the identity to copy. Images 2 and 3 are painting, lighting and uniform style references only. Create Andrei Sergeyevich Krutov, a NEW fictional male character, in the same compact tilted silver-grey photo frame as image 1. He is the head of Kefreyt's military chancellery, a loyal veteran in his late fifties: broad but not heavy face, short practical dark ash-brown hair greying at the temples, slightly receding hairline, thick straight eyebrows, clean shaven, weathered cheeks and forehead, alert warm grey eyes, firmly closed mouth with a very slight dry, restrained half-smile. Distinct identity from both reference men: do not copy their faces, no moustache, no glasses. Head and upper shoulders large and clear inside the photograph, entire head visible; subtle three-quarter pose facing slightly right. Charcoal-olive military officer tunic with restrained deep-burgundy collar piping and small dull brass collar insignia, no hat, no medals, no real-world symbols, no weapons. Match the references' realistic hand-painted grand-strategy portrait finish, muted warm skin, soft directional face lighting, subdued grey-lavender photographic background and very fine horizontal old-photo texture. The frame must match image 1: thin worn silver rim with dark bevel, slightly counterclockwise tilt, subtle dark backing shadow, portrait fills the frame. Frame and head occupy the same relative positions as image 1. Render the entire icon, including frame, isolated on a truly transparent background; keep the outer corners and edge margins transparent, no white box or checkerboard drawn in. Canvas aspect ratio 62:67, intended final export 62x67 pixels; create at high resolution but keep the face and silhouette legible when downscaled. One portrait card only, no collage, no text, no letters, no watermark, no extra decorations.
